scope: Undamaged standalone target integration; no robot or fracture work
formula: sum over accepted substeps and free nodes of norm(m_i*(v_i_new-v_i_old)-dt*F_i(x_new))
force_source: Fresh final-state float64 bulk gradient, objective cohesive force, full contact force, board and gravity; no solver last-color arrays or acceleration-inferred reaction
provenance: Additional numerical audit declared after the captured failure exposed cancelling internal errors. Uses the existing 0.0001 Ns absolute support impulse budget as a stricter sum of nonnegative local errors. Does not replace or relax global impulse, angular, energy, volume, board, replay, accuracy or sustained-support gates.
limitation: Finite solver convergence criterion for the original implicit-Euler fixture, not experimental material accuracy. Declare history/eligibility treatment separately before fracture.
